sermon.title: Satan’s 4th Appearance 06/03/2018
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer reviews Satan’s first three appearances, then reconciles 2 Samuel 24:1 and 1 Chronicles 21:1: God used Satan to move David into a census without the ransom Exodus 30 required, bringing a plague on idolatrous Israel. He links this to Micaiah’s lying spirit and Isaiah 54:16, applies it to America, and calls the church to speak up, praise God and dwell in Psalm 91.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Garbled words, including a second idol’s name, are marked [unclear]. Kept as spoken: “Gad and Micaiah” as prophets silent before David (31:09); “Jeremiah 219” rendered 2:19; “70 times 70”. Unverified: 50% of adult Americans have or have had an STD; only two venereal diseases in the 1950s versus over thirty now (26:45); 100,000 die from alcohol and drugs and tobacco kills 400,000 a year (29:09). Sensitive content kept as spoken: God has “a bulldog by the name of Satan”—“sic him” (28:16); the Governor Brown/Trump aside (25:45); legalizing marijuana; none of 20 big ministers mentioned the lake of fire (30:03). Doctrinal: God created the destroyer and does not destroy; Satan was a liar from the beginning (18:13).
